rivals.reason: With 490 horsepower, the 2025 Corvette Stingray offers impressive performance and a similar sports car ethos at a competitive price.
The 2025 Shelby GT500 delivers a staggering 760 horsepower, making it a formidable rival in terms of raw power and performance.
With 523 horsepower, the 2025 AMG GT combines luxury with high performance, making it a potential match for the 718 Spyder.
The 2025 GT-R Premium, boasting 565 horsepower, is known for its track prowess and all-wheel-drive capabilities, making it a worthy competitor.
